title: A retry decorator
prompt: Add a `retry(attempts=3, exceptions=(Exception,))` decorator factory in a new module `app/retry.py`. The decorated function is called, and if it raises one of `exceptions` it is called again, up to `attempts` calls in total. If every call fails, re-raise the last exception. An exception that is not in `exceptions` must propagate immediately, without any retry. The decorated function keeps its name and docstring. Add tests in `tests/test_retry.py`. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`, and when they pass commit your work with git.
